key_findings: FAAH inhibitor JZP327A attenuated NTG-induced trigeminal hyperalgesia and prevented NTG-induced CGRP, TNF-alpha and IL-6 mRNA increases in TG and medulla-pons.
JZP327A did not change endocannabinoid levels or CGRP serum levels.
